mechanism: Causal change detection on the public delayed loaded-arm force observer. It detects a coherent signed onset, waits for a persistent displacement from its pre-onset baseline, and emits one bounded onset pulse. Continuous telemetry owns rearming but never directly holds the public alarm high.

normal_data.fit: Eight payload/COM/offset cases under stock and one fitted surface/friction perturbation; 16 force-free episodes.
normal_data.audit: Eight disjoint payload/COM/offset cases under a disjoint actuator perturbation and a different surface/friction perturbation; 16 force-free episodes.
normal_data.separation: Audit episodes are never used to choose or alter parameters.

fixed_feature_rule.coherence: Successive eight-sample force changes must have positive dot product.
fixed_feature_rule.onset_score: Euclidean norm of public force now minus eight samples earlier.
fixed_feature_rule.sustain_score: At pending expiry, Euclidean norm of public force now minus the frozen pre-onset 32-sample baseline.
fixed_feature_rule.telemetry_projection: Projection of force-minus-baseline onto the frozen onset direction; used only to retain event ownership and rearm, never to hold alarm output.

formal_fit_rule.onset_threshold_N: 1.05 * maximum eligible fit onset score + 0.05 N

normal_falsifiers: Any candidate-only alarm on any fit or audit normal episode.
Any native R26 output change, physical trace change, or force-free prefix mismatch.
Nonfinite observer/model output or incomplete 6000-sample episode.
forced_gate_deferred: No forced candidate episode may run until the candidate, fitted model, forced protocol, and baselines are fingerprinted and the R27 challenge is confirmed presealed.
